steps.actual: A fresh isolated PostgreSQL database was created, migrations 1-42 were applied with one retained pre-upgrade player, migrations 43-47 were appended, and the actual control-plane and meta-server binaries were started against a temporary schema_migrations version 48.

subscenarios.actual: The upgrade harness recorded applied_count=42/max_version=42 before the append, retained player_count=1, and max_version=47/player_count=1 afterward.
The live control-plane process rejected startup before serving with database=48/application=47.
subscenarios.command: e2e19-live driver: run current control-plane binary with schema_migrations.version=48
subscenarios.observed: exit=1 and log contains 'verify database schema compatibility: schema version mismatch: database=48 application=47'

subscenarios.actual: The live MetaServer process rejected startup before serving against the same temporary version 48.
subscenarios.command: e2e19-live driver: run current meta-server binary with schema_migrations.version=48
subscenarios.observed: exit=1 and log contains 'verify database schema: schema version mismatch: database=48 application=47'

subscenarios.actual: The active P2P attempt was CONNECTING before and after the rejected starts; the temporary version 48 row was removed, returning the isolated database to max_version=47.

steps.observed: Both services fail closed on a future schema at live startup, and the active attempt remains unchanged.

steps.actual: Two actual control-plane instances shared the isolated database. Instance A accepted new lobbies; instance B started with accept_new_lobbies=false and authenticated against the existing active attempt. The independent admin force-abort route used a seeded active operator session and step-up token.

subscenarios.actual: Instance A and B both returned HTTP readiness 200; B reported strict_roster_v1=true and accept_new_lobbies=false.
subscenarios.command: e2e19-live driver: start control-plane A (:18080/:19090) and B (:18081/:19091), then GET /health/ready and /v1/client/config

subscenarios.actual: B authenticated the retained player, read the existing lobby with HTTP 200, and accepted the host heartbeat with HTTP 200/accepted=true for the active CONNECTING attempt.
B rejected a new lobby request with HTTP 409/MATCH_LOBBY_CREATION_DISABLED while the strict capability and existing read/heartbeat paths remained active.
subscenarios.command: e2e19-live driver: POST /v1/match-lobbies on accept_new_lobbies=false instance

subscenarios.actual: The authenticated admin force-abort route returned HTTP 200, transitioned only its target attempt to ABORTED, left cleanup_state=PENDING, and wrote exactly one MATCH_ATTEMPT_FORCE_ABORT audit record.
subscenarios.command: e2e19-live driver: POST /v1/admin/match-attempts/{abort_attempt}/force-abort with admin bearer and X-Admin-Step-Up

subscenarios.actual: The driver stopped both owned instances and removed only its own lobbies/admin rows; no E2E fixture attempts or schema48 row remained.
subscenarios.command: e2e19-live driver deferred cleanup plus isolated PostgreSQL postcheck
subscenarios.observed: schema_max=47; schema48_rows=0; e2e19_lobbies_after_driver=0; e2e19_admin_users_after_driver=0; e2e19_admin_sessions_after_driver=0; e2e19_active_attempts_after_driver=0

steps.observed: The draining instance continued serving existing authoritative context and heartbeat, blocked only new lobby creation, and the live admin route preserved the cleanup lease for asynchronous cleanup.
